metadata.title: Sphere decomposition for finite subgroups of 3-manifold mapping class groups
metadata.abstract: For a closed, oriented 3-manifold $M$, we show that any finite subgroup of its mapping class group preserves an isotopy class of filling sphere system on $M$. This is an isotopy version of the "equivariant sphere theorem" of Meeks-Yau. As part of our analysis, we establish a bijection between simplices of the Guirardel--Levitt outer space for $\pi_1(M)$ and filling sphere systems in $M$, generalizing an argument of Hatcher. We also compute the image of $\mathrm{Homeo}(M)\to\mathrm{Out}(\pi_1M)$ for any such $M$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 对闭定向三维流形，研究映射类群有限子群与填充球面系统的相容性。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明每个有限子群保持某个填充球面系统的同痕类，并建立 outer space 单纯形与球面系统的双射及 Homeo→Out 的像计算。
analysis.limitations: 结论是同痕层面的等变球面定理；保持同痕类不自动等于任意有限映射类子群都已实现为指定的几何群作用。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
